column2: Faith and Frontier: Historical AI Configuration

Choose the course of the campaign. Historical mode directs supported AI decisions toward their documented paths, with dated diplomacy, colonial agreements and Balkan developments. Existing treaties, wars and territorial conditions still matter. Your choices and explicit railroading settings take precedence. Normal mode retains the current GFM and submod behavior.

The union with Eastern Rumelia has strengthened the principality, but Ottoman suzerainty still limits its standing abroad. The government seeks recognition as an independent kingdom through a diplomatic settlement with Constantinople.

Sofia seeks to end the remaining bond of suzerainty. Recognition would acknowledge the government already administering Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia, without settling the other contested frontiers of the Balkans.
